03412 Yarmuwth {yar-mooth'}

源自 07311; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Jarmuth 7; 7

耶末 = "高地"
1) 在猶大低地有王的迦南城巿
   且位於希伯崙與拉吉中間
2) 以薩迦的利未城分配給革順族利未人 (#書 21:29|)
record.edic_text:
03412 Yarmuwth {yar-mooth'}

from 07311;; n pr loc

AV - Jarmuth 7; 7

Jarmuth = "heights"
1) a Canaanitish city in the lowlands of Judah with a king and
   located between Hebron and Lachish
2) a Levitical city of Issachar allocated to the Gershonite Levites
